tasks.summary: Added reusable effect policy helpers, exported them publicly, and covered allow/missing/error behavior with a focused test.
Enforced compact workflow graph effects in startRun before runtime state initialization and covered denied/allowed direct starts.
Enforced callable package and dispatcher registry effects before starts/calls, preserving read-only dispatcher behavior and adding focused boundary tests.
Added repeated and comma-separated CLI allow-effect parsing, wired policies into start/call/dispatch actions, and covered CLI grant behavior.
Documented deny-by-default effect enforcement, CLI allow flags, read-only exceptions, and non-goals.
